source_recommendation.reason: Preserve newly learned low-speed/forward tracking and improved right-foot peak clearance; keep8000 as standing benchmark. Full restart discards verified capabilities.

priorities.problem: Backward rest remains a stable policy outcome
priorities.evidence: Standing and RSI at-0.2 settle to0.00020/0.00127m/s with zero falls. The-0.2 reference pool has153 nonquiet B4 windows. Thus failure is not only standing initiation or absent/quiet references.
priorities.candidate: Test a bounded signed backward-progress task bonus and sufficient backward exposure; align expert sampling with requested direction/speed while retaining real coherent histories. Keep the entire command range and forward/zero acceptance gates.

priorities.problem: Persistent turning while forward vx tracks correctly
priorities.evidence: Six complete forward gait cycles all have negative mean wz; abs cycle mean0.1343rad/s, quaternion heading change-44.13deg over6.18s.
priorities.candidate: Separate lateral-velocity and yaw tracking tolerances from the speed-dependent vx tolerance; test stronger motion yaw/side constraints without restricting natural oscillation solely by instantaneous mean-abs metrics.

priorities.problem: Right swing remains brief despite sufficient peak height
priorities.evidence: Right sole P95=23.18mm but below1cm89.03% of forward window; criterion<=85% still fails.
priorities.candidate: Audit scuff kinematics: current penalty uses foot-link origin velocity, which can penalize legitimate rolling even if its lowest contact point is nearly stationary. Verify this on real recorded q/dq/root states before increasing clearance/scuff weights; then consider flight-duration shaping if needed.

priorities.problem: Zero-command knee oscillation regresses within passing threshold
priorities.evidence: All zero windows pass3deg, but max knee span rises from0.055deg to2.271deg. First brake confirms2.06s, beyond2s.
priorities.candidate: Preserve8000 quiet-policy behavior as benchmark; test targeted static damping/retention without slowing braking or changing PD/observations.

limits: These are candidate mechanisms, not proven individual causes; no exp1.7 training has started.
Do not use quiet-RSI filtering as the sole purported fix for-0.2: those candidates are already nonquiet and final RSI still stops.
A complete candidate must pass CPU consistency checks and actual9000-source GPU preflight before its formal run.
